The SourceForge REST API provides programmatic access to project management, wikis, issue trackers, discussions, blogs, and administrative functions. All endpoints are prefixed with /rest/ and follow the project tool path pattern. Supports OAuth 2.0 and OAuth 1.0 authentication.
